description:
Official music video for "You Were Meant For Me" now in HD, from the album Pieces Of You.

A special 25th anniversary edition of Pieces Of You is coming November 20th. We put a lot of TLC into finding rare items and entire unheard concerts and the mastering. I think you will love it. Available as a 4-CD box set, plus 4-LP, 2-CD and digital editions. Pre-order yours today: https://found.ee/jewel-poy25-s

I'm also going to be doing something special that I've never done before for the anniversary of Pieces Of You, which is sing the entire album from top to bottom. This is is happening on November 20th. Pre-order any a deluxe edition in the webstore & you'll get a ticket to the livestream: https://found.ee/jewel-poy25tickets-s.
